The '''skirmish on the New Umboo Lightstation''' was a minor conflict between [[Tawntoom]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] against [[Mungo Baobab]] and his allies.<ref name="TotRC" /> Baobab and his droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were in search aboard the ''[[Caravel (starship)|Caravel]]'' for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] when a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] from the [[New Umboo Lightstation]] directed them inside. The three were mistaken for Imperial emissaries but were later caught out and apprehended when [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]] and his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] arrived.

R2-D2 managed to liberate both Baobab and the prisoner [[Noop Yeldarb]] before saving C-3PO. The four managed to flee the station aboard a [[cloudcraft]] after their escape triggered [[Nergon-14/Legends|Nergon-14]] reserves that fell on the engines. This caused a cascade of failures that resulted in the station colliding with an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]].<ref name="TotRC" />

Baobab and his allies managed to flee the station after [[Bisad Koong]] and [[Gaff]] fled with Screed aboard Baobab's ''Caravel''. This development also enabled for Yeldarb to reassume control of the [[Umboo lightstation]] which Koong had shut down and for him to direct Baobab to Roon.<ref name="TotRC" />

==Background==
{{Quote|At last, a map to the Roon system!|Mungo Baobab to C-3PO and Krox|<ref name="TotRC" />}}
In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], not long following [[Skirmish on Biitu (15 BBY)|his struggles]] on [[Biitu]], [[Mungo Baobab]] resumed his quest to locate [[Roonstone]]s and blaze a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]] to [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] from [[Manda/Legends|Manda]] for the [[Baobab Merchant Fleet]], a dream that his family long held. To that end, Baobab, with his droid companions [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] in tow, organized to meet his contact [[Krox]] in a local [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] to secure from him a map to the [[Roon system/Legends|Roon system]]. However, their meeting was disrupted by three [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] who were seeking to arrest Baobab. R2 managed to amplify the stormtrooper's audio sensors in order to distract them, securing Baobab and the droids enough time to flee on their speeder to the [[Baobab Archives]] to decode the information.<ref name="TotRC" />

R2 managed to translate and record the information that Krox had given Baobab; C-3PO translated that the Roon system was located within a dust cloud referred to as the [[Cloak of the Sith/Legends|The Cloak of the Sith]]. Baobab and the droids departed Manda aboard the ''[[Caravel (starship)|Caravel]]'' and followed the [[Rainbow comet|Rainbow Comets]] in the direction of the Roon system, precisely according to the information that R2 had recorded. However, emerging from the dust cloud, the ''Caravel'' was locked in a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] and guided inside the [[New Umboo Lightstation]].<ref name="TotRC" />

==The skirmish==
[[File:Droids-trailroon.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Baobab and the droids meet Bisad Koong and Gaff.]]
{{Quote|Screed?!''"<br />"''So, we meet again, Baobab.''"<br />"''Not for long.''"<br />"''Don't waste your energy.|Mungo Baobab and Terrinald Screed confront each other|<ref name="TotRC" />}}
The ''Caravel'' was guided inside and Baobab and the droids encountered [[Bisad Koong]] - the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] for [[Tawntoom]] province on Roon - and [[Gaff]]. Both were under the impression that Baobab and the droids were Imperial emissaries that Koong wished to conduct business with. The trio kept up the pretence (being shown Koong's operations) until [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]] and two stormtroopers arrived for the meeting with Koong; this revealed Baobab and the droids and imposters with them fleeting and Screed's stormtroopers taking flight after them. The stormtroopers managed to deactivate the droids while Gaff incapacitated Baobab when the latter was cornered.<ref name="TotRC" />

Screed decided that Koong could keep the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] while he wanted Baobab thrown into a [[force cage]] containing [[mupple]]s and to have C-3PO prepared for a memory wipe since he had use for a protocol droid. Gaff went to oversee the [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipe]] while R2 was immediately put to work moving cargo. Baobab, meanwhile, met fellow prisoner [[Noop Yeldarb]], whom he learnt originally oversaw the former [[Umboo lightstation]] before Koong closed it and imprisoned him. R2 managed in the moments after to distract the stormtroopers with smoke so that he could see to Baobab's release, narrowly dodging a blaster bolt that disabled both force cages. This enabled for them to distract Gaff long enough to free 3PO from his restraints and preventing the memory wipe from successfully taking place.<ref name="TotRC" />

[[File:BaobabForceCage-TotRC.png|thumb|right|200px|Baobab in the force cage with mupples, alongside Noop Yeldarb.]]
The four managed to flee their captors but in the ensuing commotion Gaff ordered the stormtroopers to keep the crates of [[Nergon-14/Legends|Nergon-14]] from hitting the engines. However, the troopers were unable to do this, and the explosives hit the engines, thereby causing a cascade of failures that put the ship on course for a collision with a nearby [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]]. This forced Koong and Gaff to flee with Screed aboard Baobab's ''Caravel'', and forcing Baobab and his allies to flee on Koong's [[cloudcraft]] just before the station collided with the asteroid belt in an explosion that severely impacted Koong's [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] operations.<ref name="TotRC" />

==Aftermath==
Screed was unimpressed with Koong's performances, having already been disappointed with Koong's operations, and ordered that he and Gaff be locked in the brig, which was a temporary measure. Meanwhile, Yeldarb was able to reassume control of the Umboo Lightstation, and he managed to direct Baobab and the droids to Roon. The mupples were also safely aboard the cloudcraft, much to 3PO's dismay as the mupples had taken a particular liking to him.<ref name="TotRC" />
